what: Round 1347. The Champions League group stage format of the four seasons Club Manager's eras start in (2005-06, 2010-11, 2015-16, 2020-21), held as DATA with the pages it was read from, plus the real 2026-27 nights the league phase is played on. src/lib/worldCompetition.ts states these numbers and scripts/simWorldUcl.mjs section 0 fails if the two disagree. The league phase itself is Round 1228's ledger (scripts/data/cmUclFormat.json), read and never edited here.
rules: verified needs two sources from two publishers on two hosts, none a wiki. A club's own site counts as a publisher apart from UEFA.
onePublisher and toVerify rows are marked, never filled, and no constant may stand on them: their usedBy list is empty and section 0 holds that.
A literal is a line the page reader quoted from the page on the read day. A figure a row states is printed, in digits or in words, by two of its publishers, each in a line about that figure.

A row names the seasons it speaks for, by starting year. A page about one season speaks for that season only; a page about the whole group stage era (2003-04 to 2023-24) speaks for every season in it, and its row says so in periodNote.
What the game plays in place of a real rule it does not model is written under standIns, never as a row.
standIns: Pots: the game seeds all four pots by its own strength, the holder first when the save knows one. No club coefficient is kept, so the real pot rule of each season (G2) is recorded and not played.
2005-06: holders Liverpool entered through qualifying and had no country protection that season (G3-2005). The game applies the association rule to every club.
The quarter-finals and semi-finals follow the bracket order the participant's engine already uses, not the open draw the real ones had.
The nights sit on the game's own calendar. The real 2026-27 months (N1) are recorded for their order, and the screen prints the game's dates, never these.

rows.fact: The group stage: 32 clubs drawn into eight groups of four; each club plays the other three home and away, six matches; the top two of each group go through to the round of 16.
rows.periodNote: ESPN, Al Jazeera and goal.com describe the format the league phase replaced, which both ESPN and Al Jazeera date from 2003 (ESPN: the previous 21 seasons, 2003-04 to 2023-24). UEFA's page is the 2015-16 draw.

literal: For the previous 21 seasons, 32 teams qualified and were drawn into eight groups of four.
The top two teams went through to the round of 16, with third dropping into the UEFA Cup/Europa League
Since 2003, the Champions League featured 32 clubs split into eight groups of four,
with the top two from each section advancing to the last 16.
Earlier, participating teams played six games in the group stage, facing each opponent home and away.
32-team group stage
Eight groups of four teams
Six games vs three teams (three home, three away)
Top two in each group qualifies
32 teams entered the draw and were split into eight groups of four

rows.fact: The 2015-16 pots: pot 1 the holders and the champions of the top seven associations (Barcelona were holders and Spanish champions, so the eighth ranked Netherlands' champions took the place); pots 2 to 4 by club coefficient.

literal: Unlike in previous years, following a change in the regulations, pot 1 for the draw was formed by the holders and the champions of the top seven associations
As Barcelona are also Spanish champions, the eighth-ranked Netherlands received the vacant seeding place.
The remaing three pots, as usual, were decided by each team's UEFA club coefficient.
The decision that Pot 1 this year would feature the reigning European champion
plus the champions of the seven highest-ranked domestic leagues in Europe
the champion of the eighth-ranked league, PSV Eindhoven, is seeded as well this year
Top-seeded status now goes to the title holder and national champions of top-ranked leagues.

rows.fact: The 2020-21 pots: pot 1 the Champions League holders, the Europa League holders and the champions of the six highest ranked associations; pots 2 to 4 by club coefficient.

rows.fact: The round of 16 draw: a group winner against a runner-up, never of the same group or the same association; the group winner plays the first leg away and the second at home.
rows.periodNote: Bleacher Report's explainer is of 2018-19, inside the same format; UEFA's two pages are the 2015-16 and 2020-21 draws.

literal: Two seeding pots have been formed: one consisting of group winners and the other of runners-up.
No team can play a club from their group or any side from their own association.
Seeded group winners will be away in the round of 16 first legs on 16/17 and 23/24 February

Seeded group winners are away in the round of 16 first legs and at home in the return matches.

Away goals: a tie level on aggregate went to the side with more away goals, in extra time too, until the rule was abolished in every UEFA club competition from 2021-22; since then extra time and penalties.
rows.periodNote: The engine already reads this through uclAwayGoalsApply (UCL_AWAY_GOALS_LAST_YEAR 2020); the row records it for the watched ties, whose rules the binding passes from that function.

sources.publisher: UEFA, Do away goals count double
literal: Since the start of the 2021/22 campaign, there has been no away goals rule in UEFA's club competitions.
Instead, two 15-minute periods of extra time are played at the end of the second leg.
the away goals rule will be abolished in European tournament knockout ties from the 2021-22 season.
But from now, this will be replaced by extra time and penalties.
If the aggregate score is level, the away-goals rule is applied.
The away-goals rule is again applied after extra time.

rows.fact: The knockout rounds before the final are two legged, one match at each club's home.

literal: The top two in each group advance to the two-legged knockout rounds which start Feb. 16.

rows.fact: The final is one match at a neutral venue.

rows.fact: The 2026-27 nights by month: matchday 1 in September, 2 and 3 in October, 4 and 5 in November, 6 in December, 7 and 8 in January; the play-offs in February, the round of 16 in March, the quarter-finals in April, the semi-finals from late April into May, the final in June. Recorded for their ORDER only: the game's nights sit on its own calendar.
